text: I paid ten cents for this game and that was too much money for it. The game could be free, but I would still be paying with the seconds of my life. This game has no right to be on Steam, next to so many excellent titles. The whole thing feels like an asset flip. The environment and zombies (I think they were zombies) are in a Cube World art style, but somehow painful to look at. I came across 3 weapons, that each have a different style. The machine gun looks like an assault rifle, but is blocky like it’s from the Quake Arena days. The shot gun has what looks like red, blue, and green paint containers strap to the side for some reason. The last weapon I got to use was melee. It was probably supposed to be a baseball bat, but it looks like a giant, chrome icicle. The game play is just generic shooting. You get a gun and use it to shoot the zombies while trying to avoid getting slapped by the zombies. Sometimes, you only get the bat/icicle and have to beat zombies to death. This is very difficult because your swing is about the same as the zombies’ swing and they attack almost immediately once in range. If you die, you start the level over. I only managed to play for nine minutes before the scenery and animation started to hurt my eyes. The cubes that form the world are brightly colored and seem to flicker at times. I had to shut it down or risk getting a migraine. And this is coming from someone who plays Circa Infinity without any headaches. Don’t waste your time on this “game”. Learn from my mistakes and use your next nine minutes doing something productive.

title: dead pixels
text: Bought this game as i had a spare bit on funds in my steam wallet and didnt know what to buy so looked through the cheaper games and saw this and thought "OK i will give it a go it doesnt cost that much",and i am really glad that i did. As soon as i had downloaded and started to play i thought i was watching a pixelated grind house flick on my pc,then the game started and the simplicity of the game was plain to see,go from one side of the screen to the other collecting items and shooting zombies as you go.Then i got to a point where i realised i had made a mistake and then started again,sooner or later the zombies get tougher (boss enemies and the like) and thats when you realise that upgrading your guns and having a certain amount of health packs is of dire neccessity.Now the graphics are ok,sounds and music repeat too much and there is no story to speak of (just get to that damn helicopter and escape),but this is another game that shows that gameplay matters more than all these things and that all a game needs to be sometimes is just FUN.Fancy graphics,music,voice overs,script none of that matters if the gameplay mechanics are no good or broken and the games no fun. Well i think that this game has that one main element that lacks in even some big triple AAA titles in spades and for that i whole heartily reccommend this game to anyone who wants a good blast of fun.
